title: Requirements State
description: Schema for the per-application requirements state file at .aidev/requirements/requirements-state.yaml. Tracks which requirement versions are implemented in an app, per implementation.

manifest_version.description: Schema version of this state file.

requirement_set_id.description: Canonical requirement set identifier from config.yaml.

implementation_id.description: Implementation identifier. Must match a key under config.yaml implementations.

iteration_id.description: Monotonically increasing iteration counter. Incremented before each diff/plan/execute cycle.

requirements_version_target.description: Semver of the requirement set version that this iteration targets.

requirements_version_implemented.description: Semver of the requirement set version last fully implemented and verified.

requirement_baseline.description: One entry per requirement tracked in this implementation.

pinned_version.description: Semver of the requirement version last implemented.

module.description: Logical module the requirement belongs to at the time it was implemented. Tracked to detect module reassignment across iterations.

e2e_test_status.description: End-to-end test status for this requirement.
